--- RESUME CONTEXT ---
[Source 1 — experience]
Work Experience:
Data Engineer II, Swiggy (2021 - Present)

Orchestrated 140 Airflow DAGs and introduced data quality checks with Great Expectations.
Partnered with the pricing team to ship a near-real-time surge pricing feature store.
Associate Data Engineer, Mu Sigma (2019 - 2021)
Wrote PySpark jobs that aggregated retail point-of-sale data for a US grocery chain.

Candidate Skills: Python, Scala, SQL, PySpark, Apache Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Delta Lake, Databricks, Great Expectations
Experience Summary: Priya Nair has over five years of data engineering experience, working as an Associate Data Engineer at Mu Sigma from 2019 to 2021 and as a Data Engineer II at Swiggy from 2021 to present. She has built and optimized batch and streaming pipelines, orchestrated large numbers of Airflow DAGs, and collaborated with cross‑functional teams to deliver real‑time data products.

Recruiter's Question: Does she know Airflow?

content: Yes. The resume indicates she has hands‑on experience with Apache Airflow, having orchestrated 140 Airflow DAGs.
